name: Roland JD-XA
description: Roland JD-XA analog/digital crossover synthesizer: four analog parts, four SuperNATURAL digital parts and eight MIDI control parts, with the program they sit in. Every block of the temporary (edit-buffer) area in the MIDI Implementation, every part's tone included.

sources.title: JD-XA MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, May 13, 2015)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from JD-XA_MIDI_Imple_e01_W.pdf (sha256 1ade5057f6111baea11646b252018f29344626340bc0a26a227c83ae4826a59c). Model ID 00 00 00 0F, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Analog parts 1-4 hold analog tones at 19 02 00 00, 19 22 00 00, 19 42 00 00 and 19 62 00 00; digital parts 1-4 hold SuperNATURAL tones at 1A 01 00 00, 1A 21 00 00, 1A 41 00 00 and 1A 61 00 00. The manual's Temporary Tone table (p8) also lists the other engine's offset under every part (an analog part's 01 00 00, a digital part's 02 00 00); those are not laid out.
The MIDI control parts 1-8 have a Part and a Zone block each and no tone or Part EQ.

Six rows are printed with a range and no name: Analog Synth Tone Common 00 11 (0-1), 00 14 (0-2) and 00 16 (0-1) (p16); Analog Synth Tone Partial 00 0A and 00 16 (0-31) (p17) and 00 53 (14-114) (p18). They are kept, unnamed, so that a dump fills every byte the manual describes; in each block the first is <block>.value and the others <block>.value_<last two address bytes>.
The manual's only worked DT1 example (p20) addresses 18 00 02 00 as Reverb Type, which its own Program Reverb table (p10) calls Reverb Switch; see examples in synths/jd-xa.mjs.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: the front panel's CC and NRPN assignments are in the Parameter Guide ("CC Assignments", referred to on p2 and p5), not the MIDI Implementation
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: reverb, delay, vocoder, TFX and MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.tones: all eight sound parts: analog parts 1-4 with the analog tone (common, partial, MFX), digital parts 1-4 with the SuperNATURAL tone (common, MFX, three partials, modify)
